  • About
      • About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

        Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research academia that is accredited 'A++' by NAAC and is ranked as one of the best research institutions in India

        Know More
        • Rankings

          Amrita University is the only Indian University in World’s Top 100 Universities in Times Higher Education Impact Rankings

          Accreditation

          In 2023, the university was awarded an A++ grade by the NAAC

          Governance

          The governance structure of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham's academic and administrative departments.

        • Chancellor

          Sri Mata Amritanandamayi Devi, affectionately known worldwide as AMMA is the founder and Chancellor of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

          Leadership

          An experienced team of professionals guided by our chancellor is the strong pillar behind this institution

        • Press Media

          News stories about Amrita and all media coverage are listed here for you to know us more

          Newsletters

          The university publishes a newsletter including news and upcoming events of the organization

  • Campus
      • Amritapuri
          • Amritapuri
            Campus

            Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham's Amritapuri campus located in the pleasing village of Vallikavu is a multi-disciplinary research and teaching institute peacefully blended with science and spirituality

            Explore
      • Amaravati
          • Amaravati
            Campus

            Welcome to our seventh campus at Amaravati in Andhra Pradesh. Amrita is a multi-disciplinary, research-intensive university and is accredited with the highest possible A++ NAAC grade and is the country’s 7th best-ranked university in the NIRF rankings 2025. We invite you to join our new Amaravati campus in various faculty and administrative positions.

            Explore
      • Bengaluru
          • Bengaluru
            Campus

            Amrita University's Bengaluru Campus situated in Junnasandra, Karnataka, aims to create graduates with a solution mindset and a high degree of ethical standards

            Explore
      • Chennai
          • Chennai
            Campus

            Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham's Chennai campus at Vengal, Tamil Nadu offers various engineering programs developed on a choice-based credit system following continuous evaluation by faculties who guide students

            Explore
      • Coimbatore
          • Coimbatore
            Campus

            Amrita University's Coimbatore campus started in a hidden village named Ettimadai provides over 120 UG, PG and doctoral programs to a student population of over 12,000 and faculty strength of nearly 1500

            Explore
      • Faridabad
          • Faridabad
            Campus

            A land that has witnessed the historical prominence of ultra-modern facilities in India. A place where science, technology, and research merge to embrace good health across a 130-acre sprawling health city campus.

            Explore
      • Kochi
          • Kochi
            Campus

            Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham's Kochi campus is an extensive campus comprising a premier multispeciality hospital, Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, School of Medicine, Dentistry, Nursing, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences, Center for Nanosciences along with a School of Arts and Sciences and Department of Management as well

            Explore
      • Mysuru
          • Mysuru
            Campus

            Amrita University's Mysuru campus situated at Bhogadi, Karnataka away from the hustle & bustle of the city combining state-of-the-art facilities offers a perfect environment that fulfills the aspirations of young minds and meets the requirements of future employers

            Explore
      • Nagercoil
          • Nagercoil
            Campus

            Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, situated in Erachakulam, Nagercoil is a beacon of educational excellence which operates under the esteemed Mata Amritanandamayi Math. Founded by Satguru Mata Amritanandamayi Devi (Amma), our institution is dedicated to providing holistic education, guided by Amma’s profound vision encapsulated in the philosophy of “Education for Life.”

            Explore
      • Haridwar
          • Haridwar

            Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham’s campus in Haridwar, nestled on the sacred banks of the Ganges, is poised to become a landmark of educational excellence. This new campus will embody Amma’s profound vision of “education for life” and her emphasis on compassion-driven research, extending the university’s mission to the spiritual heartland of India.

            Explore

Preliminary Online Round

ICPC West Asia Final Allotted Teams – 2021

ICPC Amritapuri Preliminary Rank List 2021

Qualified Team for ICPC Amritapuri Regional Contest 2021

Eligibility

Students who are currently enrolled in a university are eligible. Additionally, students who got graduated in 2021 & those who are graduating in 2022 are eligible to participate for the ICPC 2021 contest.

Registration fees per team, to participate in the online round is INR 600 /-.

Steps for online contest registration

  • Each team shall have a coach. Coach is the faculty member from the same Institution/University/College.
  • Coach creates a team in the ICPC Global Site under “Asia Amritapuri First Round Online Programming Contest” Online contest.
  • Coach is expected to create a team with the official email id. Official email id means, he/she shall use the institutional email id. While creating teams, the coach shall invite the contestants and reserve.
  • A team consists of at most 3 contestants and the Team members (contestants) shall complete their profile in ICPC Global Site. It is mandatory that all the details as required in the system should be completed before the last date.
  • The team shall pay the registration fees.

How to Pay Registration Fee

The team shall pay the registration fees of INR: 600/-. This is for the entire team.

Important Dates

 

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Preliminary Practice Round 2021

ICPC India Practice Session: September 1: 08:00 PM to 10:30 PM
It is highly recommended to participate in the practice contest to get acquainted with the platform and clear the login issues.

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Preliminary Round 2021

ICPC India Preliminary Online Round: September 4: 08:00 PM to 10:30 PM.
List of shortlisted candidates to be published on September 9

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Onsite Regional

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Onsite Regional: October 7, 8 – 2022

Registration on ICPC portal to participate in the ICPC Asia Amritapuri Preliminary Round 2021

Teams shall first register in ICPC Global Site.
Online Registration Start : July 28th, 2022
Last date to register & pay the fees: 19th August,2022
“PENDING” teams will be accepted by 20th August.
ICPC Asia Amritapuri Preliminary Round 2021 Registration is CLOSED
Last date to cancel the team with fee refund: August 27th,2022

Site Allocation List for ICPC Amritapuri Regional Onsite Contest

ICPC 2022 Amritapuri Onsite Regional Contest Schedules and Rules

Regional Contest

Registration fees per team, to participate in the onsite round is INR. 2650 /-.

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Onsite Regional 2021

October 7, 8. to be held at Amritapuri & Bengaluru campuses.
There is no separate registration for the ICPC Asia Amritapuri Onsite Regional 2021.

Selection to the ICPC Asia Amritapuri Site Regional 2021

Total slots: 160
Amritapuri: 90; Bengaluru: 70

  1. Teams ranked 1 to 10 are selected first.
  2. Teams ranked from 11 to 30 are invited with not more than 3 teams from the same institution.
  3. Top team from each institution who solved at least one problem are invited from rank 31, are invited.
  4. Remaining slots are filled according to the rank with a cap of max 3 from same institution.

Site-wise team allocation list will be updated soon on the website.

ICPC Asia Amritapuri Site Regional – Event Schedule

October 6th
Accommodation starts in hostels. Contestants can arrive at hostels directly. Show your identity cards + SMS communication from Amrita at the hostels for the accommodation volunteers to allot rooms.
Dinner will be served on 6th to all the contestants.

October 7th
Breakfast: 07:00 – 09:30
Registration: 08:00 AM – 01:00 PM
12:00 – 02:00 PM: Lunch
02:00 – 2:30 PM Getting Familiarised with Rules in the Contest Environment
3:30 – 04:30 PM Inaugural Ceremony, Instructions on Practice Contest
04:30 – 06:00 Practice Contest
07:00 – 09:00 Banquet Dinner

October 8th
07:00 – 09:00 – Breakfast
08:45 – Teams enter the contest arena and seated in front of the allotted workstation
08:55 – Teams login to the Contest Platform – User ID and Password will be provided at the workstation
09:00 AM – 02:00 PM: ICPC Asia Amritapuri Regional Contest 2021
02:00 – 03:00 – Snacks & High Tea / Coffee
03:30 – 04:30 – Problem discussion by Judges
04:30 PM – Awards & Closing Ceremony

FAQ

How to get the previous year certificate?

You can login to the ICPC Global site and you can get the Certificate from the dashboard.

How much is the Registration Fee for Preliminary Contest?

You can go to the payment link and do the payment of INR. 600 /-

How can we know whether our payment is received?

Once the payment is received your status will be updated on our Google sheet and accepted on the ICPC Global site.

What is the role of reserved person? Will the reserved person get the certificate?

In case of any emergency to the team in the absence of any person the reserved can participate. Yes, the reserved person will get the certificate.

What is the role of a Coach?
  • Coach is the faculty member from the same college as that of the team.
  • Coach creates a team in the ICPC Global Site under “Asia Amritapuri First Round Online Programming Contest” Online contest.
  • Coach is expected to create a team with the official email id. Official email id means, he/she shall use the institutional email id. While creating teams, the coach shall invite the contestants and reserve.
How many members should be in a team? Is it mandatory to keep a reserve person?

There should be three members in a team, including reserve person four members. It is not mandatory to keep a reserve person.

What is the selection process for the Onsite Contest?

Based on the performance of the online round, each regional site will decide on the number of teams to be invited for the on-site round.

What is the last date for Registration of Preliminary Round?

Last date of Payment: August 19th,2022

When is the Onsite Contest?

Will be updated later.

Time taken for the payment to get updated.

It will take minimum three working days.

When is the team accepted in the ICPC Global Site?

On the same day as payment received it will be accepted on the ICPC Global site.

A team can participate in how many regionals?

A team can participate in Two Regionals.

Do team members have to be from the same institution?

Team members have to be from the same institution.
